kdde01.title: Deep Dive: Aries in Love
kdde01.caption:
Everything nobody tells you about loving an Aries, in four depths.
They flirt like a dare, fight fast and forgive by dinner. What keeps them: feeling chosen, out loud.

kdde02.title: Deep Dive: Taurus in Love
kdde02.caption:
Loving a Taurus is a slow dive, and worth every metre.
They need the same plan every week and calm over rushing. Give them time and they come back warmer.

kdde03.title: Deep Dive: Gemini in Love
kdde03.caption:
If a Gemini asks you forty questions, that's the flirt.
Give them room to change their mind, ask "joke, or real?" when it matters, and be their favourite person to talk to.

kdde04.title: Deep Dive: Cancer in Love
kdde04.caption:
"Did you eat?" is how a Cancer says I like you.
When the shell closes, don't pry. Stay close, say "no rush", and remember their little things back.

kdde05.title: Deep Dive: Leo in Love
kdde05.caption:
A Leo flirts at full beam and needs love said out loud.
In a fight, start with what you love, then the problem. Be their biggest fan and they'll be yours.

kdde06.title: Deep Dive: Virgo in Love
kdde06.caption:
A Virgo's love lives in the details: the stuck zip, the dentist on Tuesday.
Notice their effort, ask what would make today lighter, and let them rest.

kpre01.title: They laughed at the terrible pun
kpre01.caption:
Laughing at someone's terrible pun is a love language.
Pisces saw it happen and is not okay.

kpre02.title: They saved me a seat
kpre02.caption:
Running late and someone saved you a seat?
That's the whole love story. Pisces is sobbing into the popcorn.

kpre03.title: The old couple at the bus stop
kpre03.caption:
An old couple fixing each other's scarf at the bus stop.
Pisces had to sit down. Love that lasts looks like this.

kpre04.title: "This reminded me of you"
kpre04.caption:
When someone sends you a frog because it reminded them of you.
Pisces cannot handle being thought of. Can you?

kpre05.title: They remembered the interview
kpre05.caption:
They texted good luck at 8 a.m. and asked how it went at 6.
Being remembered is the whole thing.

kpre06.title: Their dogs met first
kpre06.caption:
Two dogs tangled their leashes and their owners into a date.
Pisces watched it all from the bench, crying.
